items.text:
I wish I could recommend this game, as the description and gameplay is niche and right up my alley. A highly interactive game where you can walk around a station, do trades, walk on to your ship, undock it manually, set a course, then get up from your seat to do maintenance, chores, sorting, etc. should be a slam dunk for many a space fan. However, there is still much work to be done in terms of bugs and mechanics.

Pros:
-Arguably the best "A guy/crew in space just making it by" experience I've found yet. Big potential for Firefly enjoyers.
-Everything has a granularity to it that seems dense but is nowhere near as cumbersome as other games with a similar level of interactivity.

Cons:
-So many bugs, to the point that asking about them on the discord usually gets a reply of "just avoid that" as they've been in the game for so long its just conditioned. For example, one of the main tools you'll be using is a welder, and your guy should be able to swap the batteries on the charger, but he just drops them on the ground.
-Crew are broken/tedious to the point that many actively avoid their use, you must give them orders or they'll do nothing productive, though sometimes even that doesn't help. The only real use of crew I've found is so on longer voyages your character doesn't go insane from lack of contact.

I hope to revisit this game in the future (when it's had more development), and will update this review at that time.
items.text_zh:
我希望我能推荐这款游戏，因为它的描述和玩法很小众，正合我的胃口。一款高度互动的游戏，你可以在一座空间站里走动、做交易、走上你的飞船、手动脱离对接、设定航线，然后从座位上站起来做维护、杂务、整理等等，对许多太空迷来说本该是稳赢的。然而，在bug和机制方面还有很多工作要做。

优点：
-可以说是我目前找到的最好的“一个家伙/船员在太空中勉强求生”的体验。对《萤火虫》爱好者来说潜力巨大。
-一切都带有一种颗粒度，看似密集，但远没有其他具有类似互动程度的游戏那么繁琐。

缺点：
-bug太多了，以至于在discord上询问它们通常得到的回复是“避开那个就行”，因为它们已经在游戏里存在太久了，大家都习以为常了。例如，你会用到的主要工具之一是焊接器，你的家伙应该能够更换充电器上的电池，但他就是会把它们扔在地上。
-船员系统坏掉了/繁琐到许多人主动避免使用他们，你必须给他们下命令，否则他们什么有用的事都不做，尽管有时候即使下了命令也没用。我发现船员的唯一真正用途是，在较长的航行中让你的角色不会因为缺乏接触而发疯。

我希望将来能重新体验这款游戏（等它经过更多开发之后），届时会更新这篇评测。
